prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent pixel-art THREE KEY POSES sprite sheet for a rough knockout animation study of JUZI, NOT final polished animation.
Input image 1 is the full-body character and SWIMSUIT identity reference. Image 2 is the current in-game floating sprite and pixel style reference. Preserve this exact orange-tabby catgirl: huge round orange bob with darker tabby streaks, amber identity, orange ears, white daisy and green leaves at viewer-right temple, striped tail attached at lower back, tiny orange tabby kitten securely GRIPPING her head. The kitten MUST stay attached in ALL poses, not fly away. Preserve the opaque orange/cream ONE-PIECE SWIMSUIT with small cream sailor-style neckline, orange flower clasp, cream/orange shoulder frill; short bare legs, BARE FEET, no shoes, no socks, no shorts. Nonsexual cute chibi anatomy.
Composition: ONE wide transparent sheet, THREE equal-width cells in ONE horizontal row, generous gaps and outer margins. All three are the SAME Juzi and same head size, matching camera elevation and palette, each complete full-body visible from perched kitten to feet. Exactly 3 sprites, no duplicates, no captions or dividing lines. True transparent alpha background throughout.
LEFT key pose -- IMPACT / CONTRACT: torso hunched and shortened after a hit, shoulders raised, elbows bent close to the chest, hands lowered forward as if just knocked off their support, head tucked a little into the shoulders, knees drawn close together below her, eyes squeezed shut, small surprised mouth. She has REACTED to an impact, not crouching to jump; no fist-pump.
MIDDLE key pose -- RELEASE / EXTEND: her big head and upper chest lead UP, short arms thrown outward/up from surprise, hips below chest and two short legs trailing DOWN with tiny bare feet, a readable elongated line of action through her short torso. Legs lag the upper body; do not make the legs long. Perched kitten hugs her hair tightly and stays in contact.
RIGHT key pose -- AIRBORNE / TUCK AND TURN: head and torso subtly twist three-quarter, knees tuck toward belly with bare feet grouped diagonally toward lower-left, one short arm bent closer and the other out for balance, tail curves behind with a slight lag. The BODY pose has changed, not just a rotated copy of another cell. Her face remains recognizable and mostly visible. Perched kitten clamps onto her head, part of the silhouette.
Style: crisp cute chunky pixel art, dark brown stair-step contours and broad simple orange/cream color clusters. Prioritize clear different body silhouettes and consistent big-head proportions over detail. Keep head size consistent across cells. No painterly gradients or soft blur.
Avoid: any swimming ring, water, effects, speed lines, background, cast shadow, text, labels, checkerboard drawn into background, detached kitten, footwear, extra limbs, changing her character design. Only a three-pose full-body character sheet.
